stages.title: 3 / Review the recorded diff
stages.text:
$ python -m timemachine --plain --human diff
                                1 entry changes                                 
 Change                         Path                           Size             
 MODIFIED                       hello.py                       53 B             
--- "hello.py" (before)
+++ "hello.py" (after)
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def greet(name):
-    return "Hello " + name
+    return f"Hello {name.strip()}!"
